lines.speaker: quiroga
lines.text: You are asking me to walk out of my own campus two days before a vote I have been preparing four years for.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: You lose it. I am not guessing. You lose it seven to two on Thursday and you spend the rest of your life saying so.

lines.speaker: quiroga
lines.text: ...Then the vote is not the lever. Fine. Fine. Let me get the slate.
